new_rows.claim: T976 Race A spec (nemotron) — 5 normative decisions for 4x4.D3: (1) 20M node cap with explicit censored split, never folded into mean; (2) censored roots reported as closed/censored split without projection; (3) three controls mandatory before 4×4: null byte-for-byte reproduction, seeded-defect distinguishability, killed-run survivability; (4) partial result if uncapped run cannot finish, closed with `blocked` flag; (5) four measured values: wall, node count, per-thread imbalance ratio, peak RSS. Total armed count: 6.

notes: T976 spec for nemotron model: node cap at 20M with explicit censored root reporting (no projection into mean). Three controls required before any 4×4 number: null control (4×3 byte-for-byte reproduction + 11.6× speedup tolerance), seeded-defect control (contiguous partition distinguishability via imbalance ratio), killed-run control (mid-flight kill survivability). If run cannot finish within agent wall, close as `blocked` with partial curve committed. Five armed guards across all decisions. Out of scope: any projection of censored roots, estimated completion times, per-capacity normalization, or running 4×4 before controls pass.
